checks_run:
Worktree /tmp/rt/firstsession/repo at derby/main 2cfa17c (main had moved past 12e8e1d, so #19 is included). `bun run build` passed. All scripts and screenshots are in /tmp/rt/firstsession/out. Headless Chromium with SwiftShader, fresh contexts, Google Fonts blocked (so the font-dependent wrapping and the serif "vs" are fallback artefacts and are not reported).

1. s1_first.cjs (1280x800). The welcome is visible 0.2-0.5 s after navigation. One click on Kick off mounts the pitch about 13 ms later, and play goes live at sim tick 68-71 (1.13-1.18 s of sim time; 3.4 s of wall time under SwiftShader). Our player (index 9) has the ball on the centre spot. Answer to "seconds and clicks to the first kick": 1 click and about 1.5 s to a live ball at your feet. The first real kick is the player's own.
2. s2_journey.cjs (1280x800, real mouse play through a feedback controller on s.humanAim). Match 1 had 90 s of real play: 10 click passes. Tips came in the order run@68, restart@504, pass@1534, tackle@1865. I then fast-forwarded with __derbyMatch.clock = halfTicks*half-2 at each half. Then the celebration (0-0, +110 XP, level 2), the naming step, and Home at level 2 (tabs home and squad, 0 tab marks, prefs.marks ["home","squad"]). Matches 2 and 3: 30 s of play each, then the same fast-forward. Results were 0-0 (+100 XP) and 0-0 (+100 XP, level up 2 to 3, the level-up dialog, then the "New: Club" mark). Match 2 showed the shoot tip at tick 154.
3. s4_mobile.cjs (390x844, isMobile, touch through CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent, Pass and Shoot pads tapped). 70 s of real play: 11 pad passes. Tips run@166, restart@369, tackle@819, pass@1787, all in touch wording. Then the same fast-forward, celebration, skip, Home L2 (no mark), matches 2 and 3 fast-forwarded, level up to 3, Club mark.
4. s5_levels.cjs (desktop and phone). XP was injected (590, then 990) after a real first match, then a ranked match was fast-forwarded. The L4 dialog offers Training and Practice Normal ("Go to Training"), and the Training mark appears. The L5 dialog offers the Cup and Practice Hard, and the Competitions mark appears. Both work at both sizes. On the phone at L5 the tab strip scrolls (scrollWidth 498 vs 356).
5. s6_tipoverlap.cjs and s7_gotit_miss.cjs: tip rectangles against the HUD buttons, plus a real tap 5 px below "Got it".
6. s3_mobile_welcome.cjs: welcome in light and dark themes, phone and desktop.
7. s8_edges.cjs: back and forward during the first match; "I've played before" leading to L1 Home; tab hidden during a tip (the match paused, the tip was hidden and its clock froze at age 216 ms).
8. s9_drills.cjs: Practice skills at L3. s10_name_lost.cjs: type a name, then press "Go to the club".
9. Bun sims with the real CoachTracker, timing constants and the first-match opponent:
   - coachsim.ts and passtip.ts over 40 seeds: the first tip is 'run' while the human holds the ball in 40/40. The pass tip is shown during the kick-off possession in 20/40 (passive) and 23/40 (dribbling). The first pass tip comes at a median of 7.8 s, p90 22-25 s.
   - shootpos.ts over 30 seeds: the shoot tip is offered 52.4-52.5 m from goal in 30/30.
   - firstxp.ts: the first match earns +110 XP whatever the score.
   - pace.ts: a match is 6.2-6.4 real minutes.
10. Console: only blocked-font and file:// resource errors, no page errors.

Fast-forward was used only to end halves (logged as "FF to half/full time") and in s5/s9/s10 to set up a level.

findings.title: Welcome screen: both club names are invisible in light mode (white text on a near-white panel)
findings.evidence:
Computed in the browser on the first screen: .ob-versus .side-name has color rgb(243, 246, 241) on background rgb(242, 245, 243), a contrast of about 1.0:1. Both names are affected ("Port Ashcliff Albion", "Port Lunbridge Rovers"; log j_desktop.log line 2).

Cause:
- styles.css:741 `.ob-welcome { color: #f3f6f1 }`
- styles.css:784 `.ob-versus { background: var(--surface-2) }`, which is #f2f5f3 in light mode (styles.css:38)
- styles.css:339 `.side-name` sets no colour, so it inherits the felt card's white

Screenshots /tmp/rt/firstsession/out/d01_welcome.png (1280x800) and m01_welcome_light.png (390x844) show the crests and kit dots with blank space where the names should be. In dark mode the names show: d01_welcome_dark.png, where surface-2 is #1b2723. This is the very first screen, and the only place it tells a new player their own club's name.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/rt/firstsession/out && NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules node s3_mobile_welcome.cjs (or s2_journey.cjs: the 'welcome names' log line). Open dist/index.html in a fresh light-mode profile.
findings.suggested_fix: In src/client/styles.css give the welcome's versus panel colours that work on the felt in both themes. One option: `.ob-welcome .ob-versus { background: rgba(0,0,0,.22); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }`. The other: `.ob-welcome .ob-versus { color: var(--ink); }` to keep the light panel. Add an e2e assertion in tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs that the .side-name contrast against its panel is at least 4.5:1 in the light scheme.

findings.title: First match: the player holds the ball at kick-off but is told how to run; "click to pass" waits at least 7.8 s and is often skipped until 25-30 s in
findings.evidence:
coach.ts:104 offers 'run' at tick 45, during the kick-off, while our player is on the ball at the centre spot. 'pass' (coach.ts:108) is queued behind it and cannot show before run's minTipMs (coach.ts:184), which is 7 s for the mouse text. If the ball is lost first, take() drops 'pass' as stale.

The e2e test encodes this order (tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs:104, "'pass' is queued behind 'run'").

Sim with the real CoachTracker, timing constants and first-match opponent, 40 seeds (passtip.ts):
- The first tip is 'run' with the human on the ball in 40/40.
- The pass tip is shown during the kick-off possession in only 20/40 (passive) and 23/40 (dribbling).
- The first pass tip comes at a median of 7.8 s, p90 21.9-24.6 s.

Real browser sessions:
- Desktop (j_desktop.log): the run tip showed at tick 68 with owner 9 = me, and the pass tip only at tick 1534 (25.6 s).
- Phone (j_mobile.log): run at tick 166 with owner 9 = me, pass at tick 1787 (29.8 s).

In coachsim.ts the CPU took the ball from a passive newbie 2.8-17 s after kick-off while the Run card was still up. The owner wants the payoff fast and the brief says "first time with the ball (click to pass)".
findings.repro: cd /tmp/rt/firstsession/out && /root/.bun/bin/bun passtip.ts; /root/.bun/bin/bun coachsim.ts dribble 8; NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules node s2_journey.cjs (TIP lines)
findings.suggested_fix: In src/client/coach.ts CoachTracker.observe, either let 'pass' pre-empt 'run' when the human owns the ball (offer 'pass' first, and 'run' once he is without it), or make the kick-off tip a combined one: "You have the ball. Move the mouse to run with it; left click to pass to a teammate". Then update the ordering test in tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs and tests/coach.test.ts.

good: One click from a fresh profile to a live first match. The welcome is visible about 0.3 s after load, Kick off has focus, and the ball is live at the player's feet about 1.2 s of sim time after the click. There are no forms or quiz first.
Level 1 Home after setup is exactly the owner's ask: one hero, one big Kick off, nothing else (edge_skip_home_l1.png).

Tips use touch wording on phones and mouse wording on desktop. Each shows once and is announced. They hide and freeze their clock while paused or when the tab is hidden, and desktop placement leaves the play clear.
Leaving or reloading the first match brings back the welcome with the same opponent. A reload on the celebration lands on Home, and nothing is recorded twice.

The level-up dialogs and tab marks for Club (L3), Training (L4) and Competitions (L5) work at 1280x800 and 390x844. The mark scrolls its tab into view on phones, and the Next unlock teaser is always there.
The result dialog's XP card animates the level-up (badge flip and LEVEL UP 3→4 tag), and the celebration's headline copy is warm for every result.
Kick off stays a gentle warm-up friendly until ranked opens at level 3, and the Elo gauge stays hidden for the first ranked matches.

verdicts.title: Welcome screen: both club names are invisible in light mode (white text on a near-white panel)
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this on derby/main 96f9618, which is two merges past 12e8e1d (#19 and #17); nothing relevant changed. Script: /tmp/rt/firstsession-verify/out/v1_welcome.cjs, a fresh context per theme and size. In light mode, at both 1280x800 and 390x844, both `.ob-versus .side-name` are rgb(243,246,241) on an `.ob-versus` background of rgb(242,245,243). Computed contrast is 1.01:1. In dark mode it is 14.15:1 on rgb(27,39,35).

Screenshots:
- v1_welcome_light_1280.png and v1_welcome_light_390.png show the two crests, a red 'vs' and the kit dots, with an empty gap where the names should be.
- v1_welcome_dark_1280.png shows 'Elyhythe United' vs 'Lomcliff Harriers' clearly.

Light is the default scheme, so most first visitors see a broken-looking first screen, and this is the only place it tells them their club's name. The e2e test reads innerText, so it can never catch this.

Root cause, with line numbers on current main (the report's 741/784 are 12e8e1d's):
- src/client/styles.css:787 `.ob-welcome { color: #f3f6f1; ...felt background }`
- styles.css:830 `.ob-versus { background: var(--surface-2) }`, which is #f2f5f3 in light mode (styles.css:38)
- styles.css:339 `.side-name` sets no colour, so it inherits the welcome card's white.

Fix in src/client/styles.css: `.ob-welcome .ob-versus { color: var(--ink); }`. That keeps the theme panel, and ink is correct on surface-2 in both themes. A dark translucent panel would also fix the names, but the accent 'vs' would then be red on dark green. Add an e2e check in tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs at colorScheme 'light' that `.side-name` reaches at least 4.5:1 against `.ob-versus`.

verdicts.title: Naming step: a name typed into the box is silently thrown away when the player presses the big "Go to the club" button
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with /tmp/rt/firstsession-verify/out/v2_name.cjs: a fresh visit with halfSeconds 3, the first match played to the end, then Name your club. I typed 'Harbour Lights' into #ob-name and pressed the red GO TO THE CLUB (a click at 1280, a real tap at 390 with hasTouch).
- 1280: {before:'Vestford Athletic', after:'Vestford Athletic', headerHasTyped:false, toasts:0}
- 390: {before:'Port Lomton Borough', after:'Port Lomton Borough', headerHasTyped:false}

Screenshots v2_name_typed_390.png and v2_name_typed_1280.png show the typed name in the focused input. The big red GO TO THE CLUB is the obvious last step; the grey 'Use this name' button is small and secondary.

Root cause:
- src/client/onboarding.ts:199-201: `case 'skip': case 'done': return finish();` ignores nameDraft.
- The draft is applied only by the form's submit handler (onboarding.ts:205-224), so only 'Use this name' or Enter saves it.
- The only other rename form is on the Club tab (src/client/ui.ts:212), which opens at level 3 (src/meta/levels.ts:100). After the first match the club is at 110 XP, level 2. Reaching level 3 (300 XP) usually takes two more matches.

Fix in src/client/onboarding.ts, case 'done':
- If nameDraft.trim() is set and differs from save.club.name, run validateClubName.
- If it is invalid, set nameError, render and focus #ob-name.
- If it is valid, renameClub, o.persist() and announce, then finish().
- 'skip' can stay a discard. Alternatively, make Go to the club the form's submit button.

Test: in tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs, fill #ob-name and click [data-ob=done] with no rename click; save.club.name must equal the typed name. An invalid draft must keep the step open with the error.

verdicts.title: On phones the coach tip covers the camera and zoom buttons, and a near-miss on its tiny "Got it" switches the first match to the end camera
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with /tmp/rt/firstsession-verify/out/v3_tip.cjs (hasTouch, isMobile, first match, 'run' tip up).
- 390x844: tip rect [22,80,368,177]. It overlaps pitch-cam [285,74,368,118], Zoom out [272,126,316,170] and Zoom in [324,126,368,170].
- 360x740: the same three buttons are overlapped.
- 'Got it' measures 49x22. elementFromPoint 4 px left, 4 px above and 4-5 px below it returns pitch-cam.
- A real touchscreen.tap 5 px below Got it gave {camBefore:'CAM: SIDE', camAfter:'CAMERA: END', camMode:'end', tipStill:1}.
- 1280x800: no overlap; the tip is centred and the zoom buttons are hidden on fine pointers.

Screenshots:
- v3_tip_390.png: the CAM chip and the −/+ buttons ghost through the dark card next to 'Got it'.
- v3_tip_miss_390.png: the match flipped to the behind-the-goal camera with the tip still up.

Root cause:
- src/client/coach.css:20 (@media max-width 640px) makes the card full width (left/right 6px, top 64px), right across the .hud-tr column. That column is defined at hud.css:23 and :106, with 44 px Menu, Cam and zoom buttons from hud.css:150-156.
- coach.css:3-4 sets z-index 5 with pointer-events:none, so taps on the card's text go to the buttons underneath.
- .coach-x (coach.css:14-17, padding 3px 8px) is far below the 44 px touch size the rest of the HUD now uses.

Fix:
- In coach.css @media (max-width:640px), keep the card clear of .hud-tr: for example `right: 64px` (the column is about 56 px wide at 390), or move it to the bottom above the Pass/Shoot pads.
- Under @media (pointer:coarse), give .coach-x a min-width and min-height of 44px.
- Optionally, in src/client/coach.ts, let a tap on the card dismiss it on coarse pointers.
- Add an e2e check at 390x844 with hasTouch that the tip box does not intersect any visible .pitch-wrap button and that .coach-x is at least 44x44.

verdicts.title: First match: the player holds the ball at kick-off but is told how to run; "click to pass" waits at least 7.8 s and is often skipped until 25-30 s in
verdicts.notes:
The timing reproduces. /tmp/rt/firstsession-verify/out/v4_coachsim.ts replays mountCoach's display logic over the real CoachTracker, minTipMs and tipText, with the real first-match setup: newGame, warmupTeam(save, true), clubTeam(0.6), avoidClash, and the human kicking off. 40 seeds each.
- The first tip is 'run' at tick 45 (still the kick-off phase) with the human on the ball in 40/40.
- Mouse, passive: the pass tip shows during the kick-off possession in 18/40. Pass shown at min 7.8 s, median 12.8 s, p90 29.9 s.
- Mouse, dribbling: 26/40; min and median 7.8 s, p90 29.2 s.
- Touch: min 5.8 s (the run text is 20 words, so 5 s); p90 29.9 s passive and 15.4 s dribbling.
- The first loss of the ball comes at median 10.4 s passive.

Root cause:
- src/client/coach.ts:103-108: 'run' gates every other tip, and 'pass' is queued behind it.
- coach.ts:184 minTipMs gives the 28-word mouse run text 7 s.
- coach.ts:143-149 take() drops a stale 'pass' when the ball has gone, so it waits for the next possession.

Downgraded to minor:
- The order is deliberate and test-encoded: tests/coach.test.ts:36 and tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs:104-123.
- The run tip is useful with the ball too, since dribbling is running.
- From tick 0 the desktop controls line under the pitch already reads 'With the ball: left click pass to the pointer' (visible in v5_shoot_tip_1280.png).
- Phones have a labelled Pass button.
- The pass prompt still arrives within 30 s for 90% of new players.

Suggested fix, in src/client/coach.ts CoachTracker.observe: when the human owns the ball at the first tip, offer 'pass' first and 'run' once he is without it. Or reword the kick-off tip as one card: 'You have the ball: move the pointer to run with it, left click to pass'. Then update tests/coach.test.ts and the ordering test in tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs.

verdicts.title: The "Shoot!" tip fires at the kick-off, 52 m from goal, not near goal
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with v4_coachsim.ts, 30 seeds.

First match, dribbling human:
- 'shoot' is offered at tick 67-68 in 30/30, at 52.4-52.5 m from the goal centre.
- Because it queues behind run and pass, the tip is shown wherever he next has the ball: 11.6 to 53.2 m, with 9/24 beyond the sim's 35 m shot range.
- A passive human rarely gets it in match 1 (3/30).

Second match (run and pass already seen, SEEN=run,pass): 'shoot' is shown at tick 67-68 at 52.4-52.5 m in 30/30.

Browser (/tmp/rt/firstsession-verify/out/v5_shoot.cjs, level-2 warm-up, coachSeen [run, pass], pointer right of the player) returned {tip:'shoot', tick:80, phase:'play', owner:9=me, pos:(53.2,31.9), distToGoal:51.9}. Screenshot v5_shoot_tip_1280.png shows our player inside the centre circle under 'Shoot! Right click to shoot at the pointer. Hold the button for more power...'.

The README (line 87) and the brief promise 'near goal'. Each tip shows once, ever, so the near-goal lesson is used up on halfway.

Root cause, two places:
- src/client/coach.ts:110-111 offers 'shoot' on any possession past halfway (`x > PITCH_W/2`), which the kick-off taker reaches by stepping off the spot.
- relevant() at coach.ts:133-134 checks only `owner === me`, so a queued shoot tip can even show in his own half.

Fix in src/client/coach.ts: offer 'shoot' only in phase 'play' when the human's man has the ball within about 28-30 m of the attacked goal's centre, for example `Math.hypot(goalX - x, PITCH_H/2 - y) < 30` with goalX = attackDir(human) > 0 ? PITCH_W : 0. Use the same test in relevant('shoot'), so a queued one is dropped once he leaves the range.

Tests in tests/coach.test.ts:
- no shoot tip at the kick-off or at 45 m
- one at 25 m
- a queued shoot tip is dropped when he dribbles back out of range.

The existing tests that place the man at x=95 (10 m) still pass.

verdicts.title: Level 2's reveal (Squad, the only reveal most players see in their first 15 minutes) gets no spotlight or coach mark
verdicts.notes:
The behaviour reproduces exactly but is deliberate.

What I saw (v2_name.cjs): after the first match, prefs.marks is ['home','squad'], Home shows tabs [home, squad] and `.tab-mark` count is 0 at both 1280 and 390. Screenshots v2_home_after_1280.png and v2_home_after_390.png show a plain new SQUAD tab beside HOME. First-match XP is flat (practice Easy 30 + first-match milestone 80 = 110), so level 3 (300 XP) needs a 5-0 warm-up win in match 2 and usually comes in match 3; the pacing claim holds.

Why it is intended:
- src/client/firstrun.ts:1-6 says 'the unlocks it opens are marked seen (the celebration names them) ... and the tab marks start from the tabs now open', and firstrun.ts:29 does `prefs.marks = openTabs(save)`.
- tests/coach.test.ts:255-261: 'what level 2 opens is named for the celebration and marked seen, so no dialog or mark repeats it', expecting marks ['home','squad'] and no pending mark.
- tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs:244-246: 'Said once on the celebration: no level-up dialog and no tab mark repeat it'.
- The celebration names it: 'Level 2! Now open: Squad, Local 2P, Link two tabs and Practice (Easy)'.
- Marks work for every later tab.

The impact is small: Squad is one of only two tabs. The README's general sentence (line 95: 'after the level-up dialog') reads as if every tab gets a mark, and the first match has no level-up dialog.

If the owner wants the spotlight anyway, it is a one-line change. In src/client/firstrun.ts, keep the marks from before the XP: compute openTabs(save) before applyResult and award, or keep the ['home'] that startFirstMatch already sets (src/client/main.ts:198). Then flip tests/coach.test.ts:260-261 and tests/e2e/onboarding.e2e.cjs:245. Otherwise, reword README line 95 to say the first level's tab is named on the celebration instead.
